name: 3d-artist
description: Game-ready 3D asset discipline for Solaris: describe -> rigged, textured, engine-ready mesh. Pipeline: GENERATE (commercial: Rodin Gen-2 cleanest topology / Tripo via tripo-mcp / Meshy-6 with rig+anim API, ~$0.30-0.40/asset; open on 16GB+ GPU: Hunyuan3D-2.1 real PBR (license excludes EU/UK/Korea) or TRELLIS MIT best geometry + Hunyuan3D-Paint for PBR) -> BACKBONE blender-mcp (18.5k stars, MIT) for import/cleanup/decimate/UV/assemble/export (runs Python, drives every other tool) -> RIG (UniRig MIT humans/animals/objects via skeleton-prediction + skinning-weight + merge; Mixamo free humanoid-only via browser; Meshy/Tripo rig APIs for any creature) -> TEXTURE (gen-native PBR or Hunyuan3D-Paint) -> ENGINE IMPORT CONTRACT (static = GLB via Unity glTFast / Unreal native; rigged = FBX 2020 binary, embed media). Documents BOTH the commercial path and the open-GPU path. Distinct from Unity/Unreal developers (engine logic) and Image Generator (2D). Part of the Solaris creative cluster sharing a tool layer.
